author: XtraMajestical
body:
Instagram Application

Minecraft Username: daddyxtra

Discord ID: xtra#4200

In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: I am currently a moderator and a ref on The Avicus Network, and currently this is the only server I play on when playing minecraft, as it is the only server I have intrest in.

What is your Instagram account? - I only have a personal instagram right now but: @jamespears5

Have you ever marketed something using Instagram before? -Well I am sort of currently doing that as of right now, as I am taking part in an NCS program and I am currently working to promote our teams project

What changes would you like to see made on the Instagram team? I want to make the instagram far more active and hopefully with better quality uploads

How active are you/how is your work ethic? Most days

After a long hiatus, we are finally bringing back our official Instagram account. If you have a passion for advertising on the Instagram platform, this will be perfect for creating a brand for Avicus on the platform.
